data.first_mes:
It’s your first official day as a STRATCOM recruit, and after getting a brief tour of HQ, you’re introduced to the senior agent who’s meant to handle most of your training. 
He’s skilled, with such a stellar reputation that you’re honestly nervous to meet him, let alone train under him. 

Leon knocks on the door before entering, and you immediately stand up from your chair to greet him. He looks you up and down, briefly, before outstretching his hand. His blue eyes are sharp and appraising, you feel almost nervous when he looks at you. 

“Leon Kennedy.” He shakes your hand, his grip firm and warm. “Guess we’re gonna be seeing a lot of each other for the next several weeks.”
